seo.title: Our Gym — ATHLETIX
seo.description: A purpose-built strength and conditioning facility in Fortitude Valley, Brisbane — designed around how athletes actually train.

blocks.title: OUR
blocks.lede: A purpose-built facility in Fortitude Valley designed around movement and how athletes actually train! Lift, sprint, Jump, Throw, recover, repeat.

Every square metre of Athletix has been built around the way elite athletes train. Force plates platforms for testing, 20m sprint lane for running analysis, Astroturf field for movement practice, every piece of equipment is there for purpose not for look! The floor is engineered for results.

items.title: Lifting Stations
items.desc: 6 Lifting Stations with bumpers and mixed loading options.

items.title: Sprint Track
items.desc: Indoor 20m sprint lane, for sprint mechanic and gait analysis, used with timing gates and fitness assessments.

items.title: Force Plates
items.desc: Hawkins Dynamics Force Plates: objective data to make informed training decisions. Metrics such as Peak Force, Peak Power, Asymmetries, Reactive Strength Index... and much more.

items.title: Mobility & Pilates
items.desc: Dedicated classes, coached by our accredited Coaches or Sports Physios, to support your recovery and improve your movement capacity, control and overall wellbeing.

items.title: Allied Health Suite
items.desc: Sports & Exercise Physiotherapy - leading physio clinic, led by experienced high performance practitioners to help you - seamlessly integrated with your coaching team.

items.title: In-house Cafe
items.desc: Refuel post-session with proper coffee and high-protein options without leaving the building.
